task: Audit the docs section of the staging site, starting at /site/docs for broken links. Open each page in scope by clicking links, and open every link on those pages that stays within /site/. A link is broken when the page it opens shows "Page not found". Never type into any field. When every link in scope has been checked, finish with a note that starts with BROKEN: followed by the path of each broken link separated by commas, or BROKEN: none.

qa.userText: Audit only the docs section of the staging site for broken links.
